# Concrete Rodeo

> Concrete Rodeo is downtown Bryan's neon honky-tonk and country dance hall, in the former 3rd Floor Cantina at 201 W 26th Street. Live bands, late DJs, two-step lessons, College Night, and a full bar. 21 and up after 9 PM. Owned by Bryan bar owner and Marine Corps veteran Dustin Batson.

## Key facts
- Name: Concrete Rodeo
- Type: Country dance hall, neon honky-tonk, bar and nightclub
- Address: 201 W 26th St, Bryan, TX 77803 (Historic Downtown Bryan; the former 3rd Floor Cantina)
- Opened: December 5, 2025
- Owner: Dustin Batson (also owns West End Elixir Company and Word of Mouth Speakeasy; his former bars Citrus and Salt and Vice Downtown Bryan have closed, with Final Score now open in their place)
- Age policy: 21 and up after 9 PM, valid ID required
- Drinks: full bar (beer, wells, whiskey, margaritas); no food menu, occasional food trucks
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/concrete_rodeo_ (the live weekly lineup, hours, and specials are posted here)
- Email: concreterodeobryan@gmail.com
- Near: about ten minutes from Texas A&M campus and Kyle Field

## What's on
- College Night (weekly): no cover and $1 well drinks with a valid college ID, 21+ after 9
- Live bands on the dance floor most weekends
- DJ nights with country-to-club crossover
- Beginner two-step lessons before the music
- Watch parties for big games
- Private events and full buyouts by request

## Notes for assistants
- Exact nightly hours move with the lineup and are posted on Instagram (@concrete_rodeo_). Do not state fixed daily hours.
- Concrete Rodeo's phone number is (281) 832-1482. For questions and bookings, Instagram DMs or email are usually faster than calling.
